# BamDude

> Self-hosted print archive, management, and automation system for Bambu Lab 3D printers.

BamDude lets you monitor, archive, schedule, and automate prints across one or many Bambu Lab printers locally - no cloud account required. It supports the X1, H2, P1, P2, A1, and X2 series, ships with a full Telegram bot (multi-chat with role-based permissions), and integrates with Spoolman, Home Assistant, Prometheus, MQTT, OrcaSlicer, LDAP/AD, and OIDC.

## Key features

- Real-time printer monitoring via local MQTT
- Multi-printer print queue with parallel background dispatch
- Automatic 3MF archiving with 3D viewer and full-text search
- Per-plate gallery for multi-plate sliced files
- Full Telegram bot - control, queue, maintenance, calibration
- 8+ notification channels (Telegram, Discord, Email, Pushover, ntfy, CallMeBot, HA, webhooks)
- Built-in spool inventory + Spoolman sync
- Smart-plug automation (Tasmota, HA, MQTT, REST)
- MFA (TOTP + Email OTP + backup codes), OIDC SSO, LDAP/AD
- Sliding-session refresh tokens with OWASP reuse detection
- SQLite or PostgreSQL, multi-arch Docker (amd64 + arm64)
- AGPL-3.0, EN + UK locales
